text:
nora_sales: New presales request from AtlasCare (payer). Req: SAML SSO (Okta/Azure), SCIM provisioning ~110k objects, delegated admin across regions, RBAC mapping -> 7 roles, private VPC connector preferred, air-gap optional. They want a 3-week POC and firm estimate. Any blockers?
li_se: Should be doable. Questions: do they require SCIM over mTLS (Private only) or token auth? expected change-rate? Also need domain ownership approach for delegated admin.
nora_sales: They prefer mTLS and estimate ~3k changes/day.
samir_sec: HIPAA in-scope. Need BAA before PHI. For keys: BYOK in Private is supported; keys stay in customer KMS. Draft Q resp: "Customer-managed KMS supported for Private deployments; Redwood stores only envelope-wrapped keys and does not have access to raw key material. Audit logs can be exported to customer S3 or forwarded to their SIEM."
kevin_soleng: For scale and mTLS, this is Private. Initial bulk import + delta polling recommended. SCIM bulk for 110k and then poll every 5-15m. Delegated admin requires domain-proof per region (DNS TXT or signed assertion).
kevin_soleng: POC checklist for AtlasCare:
- IdP SAML metadata (cert, entityID, ACS)
- SCIM service account + mTLS client cert (if Private)
- RBAC mapping CSV (group_external_id,group_name,assigned_role)
- domain verification access (DNS)
- network allowlist + proxy info
- KMS/BYOK plan + BAA signed
Sample RBAC CSV row:
billing-admins,Billing Admins,billing_admin
Sample SCIM PATCH (role replace):
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{"op": "Replace", "path": "roles", "value": ["billing_admin"]}] }
kevin_soleng: SAML ACS for POC: https://poc.atlascare.redwood.example/saml/acs. We support RelayState and overlapping cert rotation to avoid downtime.
samir_sec: Caveats: 1) mTLS + Private means on-prem connector install window ~3 business days; 2) air-gapped inference reduces telemetry and live eval features; document in questionnaire.
nora_sales: Cost ask: can you ballpark a 3-week Private POC (connector + install + eng support)?
kevin_soleng: Ballpark: Private staging & connector work $20k, installer & runbook $7k, SE support $5k -> total ~$32k. Air-gapped on-prem inference nodes add ~$40k. Final quote after finance/legal review.
